{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH
filtered = df[(df['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (df['customer_segment'] == 'new')]

# Compute the number of such customers and the number who converted
num_new_paid_search = len(filtered)
converted_count = filtered['converted'].sum()
conversion_rate = converted_count / num_new_paid_search

# Print all required values
print(f"Number of NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH: {num_new_paid_search}")
print(f"Number of conversions: {converted_count}")
print(f"Conversion rate: {conversion_rate}")

# Return the filtered data for inspection
filtered.head()"}
